purpose: independent recomputation of the published 0/362 alpha-gate claim

cell_reconstruction.gate: normal-approx 95% lower bound of the cell mean > 0 (reconstruction, not the tribunal CI)

verdict.why_the_denominator_moves: the sidecar is an ACCUMULATED history -- cells are kept across runs and carry last_seen (2 distinct dates), while a run-scoped sweep counts only the cells it saw. Neither peer artefact ships the cell list, so 362 cannot be rebuilt; the published pair (361/362) disagrees with itself by one and with the sidecar by 90.
verdict.headline: The substance of the claim holds: 0 of 69 symbols and 0 cells pass the alpha gate, under every candidate rule and every source. The DENOMINATOR does not hold: '0/362' should be published as '0 cells pass, denominator unresolved'.

published.finding: PROGRAMME-WIDE: 69/69 symbols beta_dominant; 0/69 and 0/362 cells pass the alpha gate. Zero alpha anywhere in the canonical surface.

provenance.published_by: buffy (freebuff) so the 0/362 claim is independently recomputable outside one worktree
provenance.note: numbers are the peer's, unchanged; this block only records where they came from

notes: cells are counted from the history file the tribunal reads, not from the ledger (the ledger has no cell dimension)
a mismatch on cells_total is a denominator disagreement between two peer artefacts, not evidence about alpha
cells_source tells you whether the denominator came from the tribunal sidecar (authoritative) or was reconstructed from the picks (indicative)
